description: This file defines an enum 'LaunchdManager' that manages starting and stopping a launch agent for the OpenClaw application using launchctl commands.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Executes launchctl commands with specified arguments.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw application using launchctl.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Stops the OpenClaw application using launchctl.
